::: {#lem-rss-hessian}
#### Second derivatives of RSS

The matrix of second derivatives of
$\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x})$ (@exm-rss-slr)
with respect to $\intcoef$ and $\coef{x}$ is positive definite
at every $(\intcoef, \coef{x})$ when $S_{xx} > 0$ (@def-centered-sums),
and equals

$$\begin{pmatrix} 2n & 2 n \bar{x} \\ 2 n \bar{x} & 2 \sumin \predvar_\iobs^2 \end{pmatrix}.$$
:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-rss-hessian.

:::
